messages:
rebecca: heads-up — customer FinTechCo says outputs got noticeably more terse after the morning model bump (hosted). They sent before/after snippets and want repro + fix. Can triage?

omar: pls paste the examples and the request_id if they included one. also does customer pin model or use default? :eyes:

rebecca: pasted samples from the customer below (they anonymized ids). prompt: 'Explain our KYC onboarding flow to a non-technical product manager.'

rebecca: ```
# BEFORE (old model v2.9)
Assistant: Sure — here’s a step-by-step walkthrough of a standard KYC onboarding flow: 1) Customer submits identity docs (ID/passport) via our secure form. 2) We extract fields and run automated checks (ID validity, MRZ parsing). 3) We perform liveness checks with selfie match. 4) If automated checks pass, create account and flag for monitoring. 5) If fails, escalate to manual review with checklist. Considerations: explain risk scoring, fallback times, data retention period, and sample error messages.

# AFTER (v3.1 rolled this morning)
Assistant: Upload docs, run checks, liveness, create account or manual review.
```

rebecca: customer says style changed across many prompts — fewer examples, less explanation, more one-liners. they included request_id: rq_20240412_77a9. they call via hosted api (no pin).

mike: thanks. can you also paste the exact API payload they used? need to check model param + any system messages.

rebecca: their sample request (from support logs):

rebecca: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-3.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain our KYC onboarding flow to a non-technical product manager."}],"temperature":0.2,"max_tokens":250}'
```

deploy-bot: [deploy] redwood-chat-3.1 canary → hosted pool at 2024-04-12T09:18:44Z (canary 15% traffic) :rocket:

sophia: product did push a small system-prompt tweak in the canary yesterday to encourage brevity (cost experiment). it was supposed to be opt-in for certain teams but looks like the template leaked to the hosted default chat template. logging an incident.

kevin: that matches what i see in config history — a change to the default assistant system message for redwood-chat-* at 09:15 UTC. it includes a line: 'Be concise and prioritize short answers to save tokens.'

mike: i can repro locally by calling redwood-chat-3.1 without custom system msg. i get compressed outputs similar to customer's. token counts also down ~35% on same prompts. looks like the system instruction is the root cause.

omar: can we rollback the template quickly for hosted? customer is asking for a rollback or a way to pin to previous behavior.

sophia: rolling back the default system message for hosted canary now. pushing patch to revert the briefness line and re-deploying at 09:28 UTC — will notify once live.

deploy-bot: [deploy] revert/redwood-chat-default-system-msg → hosted at 2024-04-12T09:28:07Z :white_check_mark:

rebecca: i told the customer we found the likely cause (accidental template change in canary) and that we are reverting, ETA ~10m. they asked for a temporary workaround — how can they pin behavior now?

mike: short term: customers can pass an explicit system message to override the default. e.g. include message: {role: 'system', content: 'You are a helpful assistant. Provide clear, step-by-step explanations and include examples when helpful.'} that will restore prior verbosity. also advise increasing max_tokens if needed.

sophia: product will follow up with a postmortem and stricter gating on default-system changes. also adding a feature flag to opt-in brevity experiments per account going forward.

rebecca: customer replied: 'Appreciate the quick response — we see responses lengthening again, plz confirm when fully rolled back.' i'll monitor and update.

kevin: confirm — runtime metrics show average response length trending back up to baseline for hosted pool in last 2 mins. keeping an eye on canary ratio.

rebecca: closing loop with customer. will attach their full logs and ask if they'd like us to pin them to previous model while we complete PM follow-up. thanks all. :raised_hands:
